topic: How to further improve the two forked Pi extensions built in packet 008 (pi-cache-optimizer's DeepSeek-guard fork at .pi/extensions/pi-cache-optimizer/, and deep-pi's hardened DeepSeek-direct fork at .pi/extensions/deep-pi/; sibling specs at specs/hooks/008-pi-caching-like-reasonix/003-fork-and-guard-cache-optimizer/ and specs/hooks/008-pi-caching-like-reasonix/006-fork-and-improve-deep-pi/). Find concrete, evidence-based improvement opportunities in correctness, test coverage, telemetry/observability, cost-economics, and maintainability for both forks. Known open limitations to build on rather than re-discover from scratch: deep-pi's /deeppi report still does not surface its full body non-interactively even via pi --mode rpc; deep-pi keeps no persistent stats file unlike pi-cache-optimizer; one live regression check was blocked by a missing opencode credential rather than resolved; pi-cache-optimizer's cold-start cache-write behavior for newly-added models has not been characterized.
